name: github-search
description: Search GitHub's public corpus — repos, code, or issues. Free, no auth (rate-limited to ~10 req/min unauthenticated). Use when the user asks 'is there a library that does X?' or 'has anyone solved this issue before?'.

query.description: Search string (GitHub's normal search syntax, e.g. 'transformer language:python stars:>1000').

author: aashir-athar
